Paperclip is the app people use to manage AI agents for work.
 
Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents.
 
If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.
 
Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs

items.title: Show HN: Divot.css – a simple skeuomorphic button style
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN, I wanted to share this stylesheet for a skeuomorphic button that comes from a project I've been working on. Hope you find some interest in it
I wanted to capture some of the physicality of real buttons so I've been playing with this "soft divot" concept. It's a border style that creates an illusion of the button sitting flush on the page.
Skeuomorphic buttons have been around forever. What I think is different here is this idea of maintaining the button face on the same plane as its back

items.title: Show HN: Trade Lord, inspired by Drug Lord 2, quick daily leaderboard game
items.contentSnippet:
Buy low in one city, travel, sell high. 15 days. Everyone plays the same market each day, and everyone ends up on the leaderboard.
I used to play Drug Lord 2 nearly 20 years ago and loved it! I forgot about it until recently when I accidentally stumbled across it again.
I'm a software engineer but also wanted to learn how to use Claude Code, so I challenged myself to make a similar game that was more family friendly. It's a web game designed to be played on a PC or phone.
It's vanilla TypeScript

items.title: Show HN: Nibia Fabric – Turn everyday computers into a shared AI compute cluster
items.contentSnippet:
I built NIBIA Fabric, an open-source distributed LLM inference system that pools CPU and RAM across macOS, Linux, and Windows machines.
It builds on llama.cpp, with capacity-aware scheduling, adaptive memory reservation, persistent tensor caching, and an OpenAI-compatible API.
I’ve validated the current alpha on three physical machines across several models, including a 30B-class Qwen model, as well as GPT-OSS 20B. Feedback on the architecture and use cases is very welcome.
